newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Speedy Wheels says has partial bid.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Speedy Wheels says has partial bid.

text.p: Wheel manufacturer and distributor Speedy Wheels said on Thursday it received an offer from Harvest Court Industries Berhad to buy 40 percent of Speedy's shares at 37 cents per share.
Simultaneously Harvest Court also said in a statement lodged with the Australian Stock Exchange that it offerred nine cents per option to acquire 40 percent of all listed options in Speedy Wheels.
The offers were conditional on Harvest Court becoming entitled to a minimum of 33 percent of the combined total of fully paid shares and listed options in Speedy Wheels Limited.
Harvest Court also said that the offer would probably be funded by thE issue of additional stock in Harvest Court Industries Berhad.

"It is our intention to enter into an arrangement with a financial institution acceptable to directors of Speedy Wheels Ltd so that shareholders and option holders in Speedy Wheels Ltd may choose to accept payment either in the form of cash, or in the form of shares in Harvest Court Industries Berhad," Harvest said.
Speedy's shares last traded at 25 cents on Wednesday.
